title: Silhouette Double Exposure — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Outer form
scenes.purpose: Establish the locked head silhouette against a cool fog horizon and bring in the copy outside the silhouette.
visuals: Silhouette fills with deep navy value
Copy fades up on the calm left plate

beats.development: Outline strokes in and the dark outer value fills the matte; eyebrow and headline rise in.

scenes.title: Interior exposure
scenes.purpose: Reveal the interior night-city scene through the stable contour with its own independent pan while the network grows.
visuals: Feathered bottom-up wipe inside the matte
Interior skyline, stars and network pan left and settle down while the outline stays locked
Network edges and nodes connect from the glowing idea node

beats.development: Interior scene wipes up through the silhouette while panning independently.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Network finishes connecting as the interior pan decelerates toward registration.

scenes.title: Alignment hold
scenes.purpose: Align the interior horizon with the exterior horizon and connect to a fixed outside landmark, then hold.
visuals: Interior horizon brightens on the exterior horizon line
Dashed connector draws to the landmark on the horizon
Landmark node pops and the frame holds

beats.development: Horizons register; connector reaches the outside landmark, which appears only on arrival.

captions: An idea becomes a connected system

findings: Outer form is established before the interior reveal; one continuous interior move; all motion settled by 2.65 s.
justifiedHolds: 2.65–3.0 s hold on the horizon alignment, as the style requires a pause on the join.

notes: Canvas 2D renderer with a destination-in alpha matte; GSAP single paused timeline owns every animated property.
No preview recipes supplied; demonstrates the catalogue characteristic action.
